customerOutcome: Inspect and download minimal native workflow diagnostic metadata for exceptional support without granting support access or automatically sending private data.
entryConditions: Current private native workflow-run view passed exact company/workflow/run and account admission.
Effective V9 presentation is enabled; pending, checking, denied or unavailable native reads do not mount report controls.
exitConditions: Download requested after explicit preview; browser initiation is not proof that a file was saved or sent.
A source or authority reread unmounts the open private report.

content.supportingCopy: Review the exact JSON before downloading. Nothing is sent automatically.
displayedState: Exact native company, workflow, run and revision references, revision state, source updatedAt, recorded run status and explicit live/test purpose.
Trace summary contains only bounded status counts and payload-unavailable count. Actual empty history differs from unavailable history.
Names, customer text, branch names, logs, prompts, errors, actor IDs, credentials and stop commands/receipts are omitted.
Recorded execution only; no current activation or independent business verification claim.

inputs.label: Report to download
inputs.help: Company/resource UUIDs are included. Review before choosing download.
inputs.validation: Strict schema with exact native binding and bounded consistent counts; unknown fields refuse export.
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: Explicit projection from the current authorized native view; no raw source object spread.

primary.label: Download report
primary.operation: Validate and download only the inspected JSON through a local browser Blob after an explicit click; release the object URL.

secondary: Cancel and return focus to the invoking control
Contact support through the user-confirmed mailto address without prefilled private report data
Refresh the native run outside the dialog to recheck source and authority

canonicalReadDomains: Existing native workflow-run experience owner and actual account/company/workflow/run admission
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: No native write, audit event, network send, clipboard or browser persistent storage. Explicit customer download only.
systemWork.authorityEffect: No new grant or support-session approval. Resource IDs do not authorize support inspection; V6 scoped support admission remains necessary.
systemWork.asyncWork: Only the existing private native read. Its checking/error branches unmount the report control and dialog.
systemWork.receipt: Fixed Download requested announcement denotes browser initiation only, not saved-file, external delivery or business-result proof.

states.loading: No report controls while the native view is pending or fetching.
states.empty: A native available trace with zero attempts exports available/zero; it does not fabricate successful work.
states.partial: Unavailable trace exports unavailable without guessed counts.
states.stale: Current view rechecks unmount the preview; late prior source responses remain handled by the existing private query epochs.
states.validation_error: Invalid or mismatched native source refuses report construction; strict export validation refuses additional fields.
states.system_error: A fixed translated download error excludes private exception text.
states.permission_denied: The existing denied native read hides the report and all retained private metadata.
states.recovering: Refresh current native source before explicitly opening a new report. An earlier downloaded snapshot does not become current.
states.success: Download requested only. No report was sent to support automatically.

navigation.back: Native workflow run remains the context.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Cancel closes the dialog and restores focus to its trigger; no native or persistent browser draft.
navigation.deepLink: Existing canonical native workflow-run route; no separate report-sharing URL.
navigation.resume: Refresh current native private state and explicitly open a new preview.

accessibility.initialFocus: Native dialog focus management; labeled read-only preview and explicit footer actions.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Safe error region unless another native dialog owns focus.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Nonintrusive status; dialog remains open with cancel/download controls.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard links/buttons and native tab order; no custom keyboard trap.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Polite loading status, safe alert for unavailable current state.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Stacked current state and receipt rows at narrow width; no horizontal table.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Named native dialog, labeled read-only text area, associated disclosure and status/error announcements; no additional main landmark.

responsive.wide: Stacked current installation state and historical maintenance receipts.
responsive.mobile: Token touch targets and no columns requiring lateral scrolling.

dataShown: Exact locally exported company/resource UUIDs, fixed status/version/time/purpose and bounded status counts.
dataCollected: No new automatic collection, server report storage, support transmission, telemetry or persistent browser storage.
sensitiveFields: The current native source remains private; export excludes all customer text, names, errors, logs, actor identities and credentials.
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: No logging of report content or private download exceptions; no report body in mailto query, route or filename.

functional: Strict native binding, consistent bounded counts, unavailable versus empty, exact inspected JSON download, object URL release on success and failure.
Actual native execution, built browser preview/download, mobile axe, current source refresh and rollout compatibility.
General self-service recovery, re-authentication, support assistant, cross-domain diagnostics and V6 support-session customer UX remain open.
accessibility: Keyboard dialog/preview/footer and focus return; mobile automated checks on the exact artifact, with manual screen-reader/zoom acceptance still required.
securityPrivacy: No customer text or private source objects in exported report; no automatic send, analytics, clipboard or persistence.
Open preview is withdrawn during source/authority recheck; account/company-bound page key and native read admission retain their existing ownership.
usability: Representative exploratory and confirmatory support/recovery evidence remains pending; source tests are not human acceptance.
